rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: At the press conference after forming the second Hashimoto cabinet (8 November 1996), 橋本総理 says that the previous day, at the 138th special session, he received the Diet's designation as Prime Minister and continues to bear the heavy responsibility (昨日内閣総理大臣の指名をいただき、引き続き重責を担うことになりました), and that he formed the cabinet the previous day (昨日組閣をする際にも).

locator.heading: 第二次橋本内閣組閣後記者会見 平成８年１１月８日(金)
locator.part: 冒頭発言: second paragraph (昨日内閣総理大臣の指名をいただき、引き続き重責を担うことになりました) and the paragraph beginning 昨日組閣をする際にも

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Kantei record headed 第二次橋本内閣組閣後記者会見, dated Friday 8 November 1996, has 橋本総理 open the press conference and set out the priorities he intends to take up 'as Prime Minister' (内閣総理大臣として) on the launch of the second Hashimoto cabinet.

locator.heading: 第二次橋本内閣組閣後記者会見 平成８年１１月８日(金)
locator.part: 冒頭発言: first and second paragraphs

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the same opening remarks 橋本総理 says he has done his best since receiving appointment as Prime Minister (総理を拝命) on 11 January of that year.

locator.heading: 第二次橋本内閣組閣後記者会見
locator.printed: 本年の１月11日に総理を拝命して以来
